angles.name: hero
angles.headline: Your binder has buyers.

headline_options.why: Speaks to the seller's own pile of duplicates and flips it into demand. Chosen: short, concrete, collector language.

headline_options.formula: universal claim on a specific object
headline_options.why: Echoes the site's 'We connect collectors' line; slightly longer.

headline_options.text: Cards you don't play. Collectors who want them.
headline_options.why: Clear, but two sentences and 8 words: too long for 9:16.

angles.subhead: List what you own. Collectors in Lebanon message you directly.
angles.notes: Brand-led. The subhead adapts the site's own 'List what you own, message the person who has what you want'.

angles.name: benefit
angles.headline: Listed in about a minute.

headline_options.why: Uses the site's own claim ('it takes about a minute'); kept the 'about' so it stays honest. Chosen.
Mirrors the 4-step form; punchy but less specific.

headline_options.text: Snap it. Price it. List it.

angles.subhead: Four steps: add photos, name the card, set your price, review.
angles.notes: Ease of listing. Every number is from the sell page (01 / 04 steps, 'about a minute').

angles.name: benefit-2
angles.headline: Keep every dollar you sell for.

headline_options.text: Keep every dollar you sell for.
headline_options.why: The money axis, distinct from the ease axis. True because nothing is taken out of sales. Chosen.
Captures 'you agree the terms yourselves'; softer on the money point.

headline_options.text: Nothing taken out of your sales.
headline_options.why: The site's exact wording; reads like terms rather than an ad.

angles.subhead: You agree the price with the buyer yourselves. We never take a cut.
angles.notes: Replaces the Offer angle: there is no real promotion to advertise. Avoids 'no fees' and 'free listing', which may stop being true when paid plans launch.
